j2474738754
g.text: wouldn't blame you, he's quite dashing

g.title: j3131522606
g.text: "You stand in the middle of the electrical lab with the now free Zabir. He looks at you, 'there's no time to waste, follow me.'"

g.title: j2618117225
g.text: "He leads you through corridor after corridor. He knows this asteroid like the back of his hand, every guard and their movements."

g.title: j2317673039
g.text: "Zabir is shocked. 'The rats found you? That’s amazing. It worked. Check it.' Zabir holds up an intricately embossed gold whistle. 'Rat Queen gave it to me. We need to find her.'"

g.title: j474725522
g.text: "You ask Zabir how he got here, 'No time for that,' he says, ‘we need to focus on getting out of here.'"

g.title: j1752439480
g.text: "Zabir looks back, 'Taking you to the hangar bay. We steal a ship and we get as far away from here as possible. Find the Rat Queen.'"

g.title: j3682438837
g.text: "'She gave me this whistle. The rats listen to it. She’s my friend. She’s not always nice, but she cares.'"

g.title: j1023891238
g.text: Have you shown this to Lettie by any chance?

g.title: j3137992034
g.text: i value my life too much to risk that

g.title: j3851017045
g.text: any resemblance to people real or imagined is merely a coincidence

g.title: j2593048948
g.text: "With Zabir's help you zigzag through the asteroid's corridors. He deftly dodges guards and security cameras."

g.title: j397335452
g.text: "Eventually, you come to a large door. Zabir signals to get low. You both crouch down as sneak into the ship’s hangar."

g.title: j909318506
g.text: "You crouch in the shadow of a pillar. Grineer guards can be heard nearby."

g.title: j139398752
g.text: "Without an ounce of self-preservation or forethought you run out into the open. A group of guards on the other side starts blasting. You charge head long into a stream of bullets that kill you instantly. Zabir shakes his head at your senseless act of stubborn bravery."

g.title: j3021517612
g.text: "You peak around the corner and survey the area."

g.title: j3626998615
g.text: wanna try again and not get yourself insta killed this time?

g.title: j944665330
g.text: "A Railjack is parked in the center of the hangar. The ramp into the Railjack is blocked by a guard. On one side of the hangar a dozen Grineer are busy playing a raucous game of dice. A few feet in front of you is a desk with a control panel."

g.title: j195157066
g.text: "'To get out, we need to first open the hangar bay doors,' Zabir whispers."

g.title: j3615512162
g.text: "Zabir looks at you. 'Got any bright ideas?'"

g.title: j1858393700
g.text: Let's use that rat whistle thingie.

g.title: j96301109
g.text: Make a run for the Railjack.

g.title: j1963474450
g.text: Get Zabir to attack the ramp guard.

g.title: j2992931479
g.text: "Zabir picks up the whistle and plays one long note. You hear nothing but breath. You sit and wait, but nothing happens. Not rats, nothing. Zabir shrugs."

g.title: j390228524
g.text: "You get to the control panel, but not before an attentive guard notices. You try to put your hands up to surrender but they shoot you anyways, because Grineer a mean like that."

g.title: j974825772
g.text: "You make a run for the ship, but the ramp guard spots you and opens fire. Your day, and life, ends painfully."

g.title: j1619612551
g.text: oh sure when there’s danger you send in amir

g.title: j1432383191
g.text: "Then you hear it, a crunching sound. Like chewing. Suddenly rats are bursting out of the vents all around the hangar. The Grineer guards shriek like schoolchildren and open fire. Bullets are going everywhere."

g.title: j11714248
g.text: "The rats have the guards distracted. What now?"

g.title: j2192120152
g.text: Have Zabir zap the ramp guard!

g.title: j891587487
g.text: Open the doors with the control panel.

g.title: j548849835
g.text: "You yell out, 'Zabir, get him!' while pointing at the ramp guard."

g.title: j575962559
g.text: "Zabir dashes up to the guard and zaps him. He falls limply."

g.title: j4098924179
g.text: "You sneak over to the control desk and try to operate the console while doing your best to stay hidden. You manage to get trigger the bay doors to open."

g.title: j650725798
g.text: "Against his better judgment, Zabir bravely dashes in. Even he isn't fast enough to go unnoticed. The guards open fire and Zabir is tragically killed."

g.title: j1535318695
g.text: "Distracted by the rats, the guards don't even notice."

g.title: j4178878386
g.text: one more try? keep zabir alive this time?

g.title: j3655139936
g.text: "You sense your chance and sprint to the Railjack."

g.title: j2899457564
g.text: "Zabir waves at you to get the hangar doors open."

g.title: j662690993
g.text: I promise not to kill you this time.

g.title: j3536325816
g.text: I think we can end it here. [End.]

g.title: j1078024267
g.text: "You look at Zabir and say, 'I hope you know how to fly this thing,' and Zabir says, 'I don’t, but you do.'"

g.title: j3780632421
g.text: "You power on the ship and just as you’re about to press the button to bring up the ramp and close the door, Zabir says, 'Wait! We can’t leave them.'"

g.title: j3924614817
g.text: You're right, we need to save them.

g.title: j2918486173
g.text: Please no. We really should leave them.

g.title: j3022252010
g.text: "Zabir holds up the whistle and blows."

g.title: j2193984650
g.text: "Seconds later a dozens of rats stream onto the ship. Zabir looks at you, and screams, ‘GO!"

g.title: j3220289443
g.text: "The ship lifts off. The Grineer open fire but their bullets bounce off the mighty Railjack as it exits the hangar."

g.title: j3485855719
g.text: "As rats scurry around the bridge you look out at the vastness of space, and then you confidently say, 'RAILDRIVE, ENGAGE.' As the Railjack flashes into the distance."

g.title: j3704884493
g.text: so, what did you think of the ending? was it too insane?

g.title: j749498246
g.text: phew, i was worried i got a little to wild there
